title: Labeling basics
text: Label every visible object in the frame

title: Occlusion
text: Partially hidden objects still get a box

title: Truncation
text: Objects cut off by the image edge are truncated

title: Small objects
text: Skip objects smaller than ten pixels

title: Night scenes
text: Use the brightness slider before labeling

title: Reflections
text: Do not label reflections in mirrors or windows

title: Crowds
text: Label each person in a crowd separately

title: Vehicles
text: Trailers attached to trucks are one vehicle

title: Signs
text: Read the sign text and copy it exactly

title: Truncation (old)
text: This older copy of the truncation rule is ignored

title: Animals
text: Pets on leashes belong to the animal class

title: Weather
text: Rain streaks are not objects

title: Blur
text: Motion blur does not change the box size

title: Groups
text: Use a group box only when instructed

title: Shadows
text: Shadows are never part of the box

title: Text overlays
text: Ignore watermarks and timestamps burned into video

title: Duplicates
text: Flag duplicate frames instead of labeling twice

title: Ambiguity
text: When unsure choose the more general class

title: Review
text: Reviewers may edit any box

title: Escalation
text: Escalate frames with sensitive content
